messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] plot qtl results for multiple phenotypes
parts:
>
> 1- I have many traits which analyzed separately. I want to plot the
> result of scanone for them in just one graph as many of

Call plot.scanone with add=TRUE to add an additional LOD curve to an
existing plot. Use the argument 'col' to change the color, and 'lty' to
change the line type (lty=1 is solid; lty=2 is dotted; lty=3 is dashed).

> 2- I want to use function add.thresholdline with this graph for alpha
> value, 63%, 10% and 5% if possible.
>

You can call add.threshold() repeatedly to plot multiple thresholds. As
with plot.scanone, use arguments 'col' and 'lty' to change the color and
line type, respectively.

karl
